- Everything Pulse puts in Downloads is under one folder, Download/Pulse: Share (what LocalSend and Relay receive), AI (the models), Backup, Crash (crash logs), Palette. The old folders are moved there once.
- Share: a Received files list (a picture of each, a tap opens it, sorted by newest, name or size), Pulse's own file picker, and it says at once that it waits for the other device to accept (and why a send did not go). A transfer, sending or receiving, is a notification with progress, Pause and Cancel instead of a bubble over the apps. Files: a Received row on the home page.
- Keyboard: a screenshot in the bar stays a minute while the keyboard is closed and 15 seconds once it is open, and is also kept in the clipboard history; a blocked word is gone from every list; in a web box of Pulse itself (Game Hub search) the suggestions work again.
- Icons: Material glass icons have the deep tile and soft light glyph of the Glass Material You pack, and glass icons no longer have the light patch in the top left corner. YTXTube's icon is the black tile with a white screen and bird.
- Fixed a crash in the Neofetch card (the ASCII logo).
